segment_captions.caption: A bird bath contains water with a bird partially submerged, splashing around. Another bird perches nearby on the edge of the bath.
A sparrow stands in a bird bath, drinking water while another sparrow perches nearby on the edge of the bath.
A sparrow perches on the edge of a bird bath, then flies away, leaving the bath empty.
A bird perches on the edge of a birdbath, then flies away.
A bird perches on a stone surface, slightly shifting its position.
